info.title: ChargeBee Universal API
info.description: Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform for managing customers, subscriptions, invoices, credit notes, payments, events, products, and catalog data through Chargebee's REST API.

post.description: Creates a new customer in ChargeBee.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.
